    if order['status'] == 'shipped':
        customer = order['customer']
        name = f"{customer['first']} {customer['last']}"
        
        order_total = sum(item['qty'] * item['unit_price'] for item in order['items'])
        
        if name in customer_totals:
            customer_totals[name] += order_total
        else:
            customer_totals[name] = order_total

max_total = customer_totals[max_customer]

    print(f"  {name}: {total:.2f}")

print(f"\nTop customer: {max_customer} with total {max_total:.2f}")
